title: Peppermint Shards
description: Sugary boiled-sweet shards made from caramelised sugar, corn syrup and peppermint extract. Smashed with a rolling pin into glass-like pieces.

ingredients.text: 7 tablespoons corn syrup or agave nectar

steps: Prepare a board or baking tray with a sheet of foil under a sheet of greaseproof paper, edges turned up.
Put sugar and syrup/nectar in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir constantly to stop sticking. Heat to 150–180°C (hard crack stage) — about 7 minutes of bubbling.
Remove from heat, add the peppermint extract and mix thoroughly.
Tip on to the greaseproof paper and spread to a few millimetres thick with a palette knife.
Leave to set for a couple of hours, then cover with another sheet and bash with a rolling pin to split into shards.
Store in an airtight tin lined with greaseproof paper.
notes: Serves 6–8. Use corn syrup for a clear finish, agave for an amber colour. Dip in dark chocolate for a homemade After Eight effect.
